heading.en: The Analyze feature, grouping, binning and clustering

takeaways.en: Right-click a data point → Analyze → Explain the increase/decrease, or Find where this distribution is different.
takeaways.zh: 右键单击数据点 → 分析 → 解释增加/减少，或查找此分布的不同之处。

takeaways.en: Groups combine chosen values into one category; bins cut numbers or dates into equal-size ranges.
takeaways.zh: 分组把选定的值合并成一个类别；装箱把数字或日期切成大小相同的范围。

takeaways.en: Clustering on a scatter chart finds similar points automatically and adds a cluster field.
takeaways.zh: 散点图上的聚类会自动找出相似的点，并新增一个聚类字段。

html.en: On a column or line chart, right-click a point and choose Analyze → Explain the increase (or decrease). Power BI looks at other fields in the model and shows small visuals of the categories that contributed most to the change. Find where this distribution is different looks for fields where the selected value's distribution stands out.
html.zh: 在柱形图或折线图上，右键单击数据点，选择分析 → 解释增加（或减少）。Power BI 会检查模型中的其他字段，用小视觉对象显示对变化贡献最大的类别。查找此分布的不同之处会找出所选值的分布与众不同的字段。

rows.en: Ctrl+click data points → right-click → Group, or column menu → New group
rows.zh: Ctrl+单击数据点 → 右键 → 分组，或列菜单 → 新建组

rows.en: Put five small countries into "Other Europe"
rows.zh: 把五个小国家归为「其他欧洲」

rows.en: Column menu → New group → Group type: Bin; set bin size or number of bins
rows.zh: 列菜单 → 新建组 → 组类型：箱；设定箱大小或箱数量

rows.en: Scatter chart → More options → Automatically find clusters
rows.zh: 散点图 → 更多选项 → 自动查找聚类

rows.en: Customer segments by frequency and spend
rows.zh: 按购买频率和消费金额划分客户群

html.en: Groups and bins become new columns in the model (with the group icon) that you can use in any visual, slicer or filter.
html.zh: 分组和装箱会在模型中成为新列（带分组图标），可在任何视觉对象、切片器或筛选器中使用。

q.en: You need to show a histogram of order values in ranges of 50. What do you create?
q.zh: 你要用直方图显示订单金额，每 50 为一个范围。应该建立什么？

why.en: Grouping by hand would be slow and fixed.
why.zh: 手动分组很慢，而且是固定的。

html.en: Bins on the order value column with bin size 50
html.zh: 对订单金额列建立装箱，箱大小 50

takeaways.en: Key influencers ranks the factors that drive a metric up or down and finds top segments.
takeaways.zh: 关键影响因素会对推动指标上升或下降的因素进行排名，并找出主要细分群体。

takeaways.en: Decomposition tree breaks a measure down across dimensions in any order, with AI splits that pick the highest or lowest next value.
takeaways.zh: 分解树可按任意顺序把度量值按维度拆解，并提供 AI 拆分，自动选出下一个最高或最低的值。

takeaways.en: Q&A and the narrative (smart narrative) visual are also AI visuals.
takeaways.zh: 问答和叙述（智能叙述）视觉对象也属于 AI 视觉对象。

rows.en: What drives this outcome? Which segments have the highest rate?
rows.zh: 是什么驱动了这个结果？哪些细分群体的比率最高？

rows.en: What makes a customer rating Low? "Contract = month-to-month: 2.1× more likely"
rows.zh: 什么让客户评分为「低」？「合同 = 按月：可能性高 2.1 倍」

rows.en: Where does this total come from? Drill in any order
rows.zh: 这个总计来自哪里？可按任意顺序深入

rows.en: Sales → Region → Product → Channel; AI split: High value
rows.zh: Sales → 区域 → 产品 → 渠道；AI 拆分：高值
「销售额增长 12% 至 410 万美元，主要来自 Bikes」

items.en: Analyze: the field to explain — a category ("Rating is Low") or a continuous number ("Sales increase").
items.zh: 分析：要解释的字段——类别（「评分为低」）或连续数字（「销售额增加」）。

items.en: Explain by: the candidate factors (columns or measures).
items.zh: 解释依据：候选因素（列或度量值）。

items.en: Key influencers tab: each factor's effect; Top segments tab: combinations of values with the highest (or lowest) result.
items.zh: 关键影响因素选项卡：每个因素的影响；主要细分群体选项卡：结果最高（或最低）的值组合。

items.en: It shows correlation, not proof of cause.
items.zh: 它显示的是相关性，不能证明因果关系。

html.en: Put a measure in Analyze and several dimensions in Explain by. Click + on a node to choose the next dimension yourself, or pick High value / Low value to let AI choose the dimension with the biggest contribution. Locked levels stop viewers from changing the first levels.
html.zh: 把度量值放在分析，几个维度放在解释依据。点击节点上的 + 自己选择下一个维度，或选择高值/低值，让 AI 选出贡献最大的维度。锁定的层级可以防止读者修改前几层。

q.en: HR asks: "Which employee attributes make attrition more likely?" Which visual answers this directly?
q.zh: 人力资源部问：「哪些员工属性让离职的可能性更高？」哪个视觉对象能直接回答？

why.en: It splits a total; it does not compute likelihood.
why.zh: 它拆解总计，不计算可能性。

why.en: Right: it ranks factors by how much they raise the chance of attrition.
why.zh: 对：它按各因素提高离职可能性的程度进行排名。

q.en: A user wants to break total cost down by department, then by vendor, then by month, choosing the order freely and letting AI suggest the biggest contributor. Which visual?
q.zh: 某用户想把总成本按部门、再按供应商、再按月份拆解，可以自由选择顺序，还要 AI 建议贡献最大的项目。用哪个视觉对象？

why.en: The order is fixed by the hierarchy and there is no AI split.
why.zh: 顺序由层次结构固定，也没有 AI 拆分。

heading.en: Reference lines, error bars and forecasting

takeaways.en: The Analytics pane adds constant, average, median, percentile, min and max lines, trend lines and forecasts.
takeaways.zh: 「分析」窗格可加入常量线、平均线、中值线、百分位线、最小/最大值线、趋势线和预测。

takeaways.en: Forecasting works on line charts with a continuous date axis and shows a confidence interval.
takeaways.zh: 预测适用于有连续日期轴的折线图，并显示置信区间。

takeaways.en: Error bars show an upper and lower bound around values, from fields or measures.
takeaways.zh: 误差线在数值周围显示上下界，界限来自字段或度量值。

html.en: Select a visual and open the Analytics pane (magnifier icon). What is available depends on the visual type.
html.zh: 选取视觉对象并打开分析窗格（放大镜图标）。可用项目取决于视觉对象类型。

rows.en: Average / median / percentile / min / max line
rows.zh: 平均线 / 中值线 / 百分位线 / 最小值线 / 最大值线

rows.en: Compare each item with the typical value
rows.zh: 把每个项目与典型值比较

rows.en: Line chart, continuous date axis, one measure
rows.zh: 折线图、连续日期轴、单一度量值

rows.en: Projected values with forecast length, confidence interval and seasonality
rows.zh: 预测值，可设预测长度、置信区间和季节性

rows.en: Show uncertainty or a min–max range from upper/lower bound fields
rows.zh: 用上下界字段显示不确定性或最小–最大范围

rows.en: Which points are above or below x = y
rows.zh: 哪些点高于或低于 x = y

html.en: Forecast is not available when the date axis is categorical (for example month names as text). Use a date column, and turn the axis to Continuous.
html.zh: 当日期轴是类别型时（例如以文字表示的月份名称），就无法使用预测。要使用日期列，并把轴设为「连续」。

q.en: The Forecast option is missing from a line chart that shows sales by Month Name. Why?
q.zh: 某个按 Month Name 显示销售额的折线图中找不到「预测」选项。为什么？

html.en: The axis is categorical; forecasting needs a continuous date axis
html.zh: 轴是类别型的；预测需要连续的日期轴

why.en: A legend does block forecasting, but the stated cause here is the text axis.
why.zh: 图例确实会让预测不可用，但这里的原因是文字轴。

html.en: There are too many data points

heading.zh: 离群值、异常与指标记分卡

takeaways.en: Anomaly detection on a line chart with a date axis marks unexpected points and offers an explanation.
takeaways.zh: 在带日期轴的折线图上，异常检测会标出意外的点并提供解释。

takeaways.en: Scatter charts, box-like comparisons with percentile lines, and clustering also expose outliers.
takeaways.zh: 散点图、用百分位线做的类箱形比较，以及聚类，也都能发现离群值。

takeaways.en: Metrics (scorecards) in the service track goals against targets, with statuses, owners and check-ins.
takeaways.zh: 服务中的指标（记分卡）把目标与目标值对比跟踪，包含状态、负责人和签到。

html.en: On a line chart with a date field on the axis, open the Analytics pane and turn on Find anomalies. Power BI draws an expected range and marks points outside it. Adjust sensitivity, and add fields under Explain by; clicking an anomaly opens a pane with possible explanations.
html.zh: 在轴为日期字段的折线图上，打开「分析」窗格并开启查找异常。Power BI 会画出预期范围，并标出范围外的点。可以调整敏感度，并在解释依据下加入字段；点击某个异常会打开窗格，列出可能的解释。
发现离群值的其他方法

items.en: A scatter chart of two measures shows points far from the cloud.
items.zh: 两个度量值的散点图会显示远离点群的点。

items.en: Percentile lines (5th and 95th) highlight values beyond the usual range.
items.zh: 百分位线（第 5 和第 95 百分位）能突显超出一般范围的值。

items.en: A DAX flag such as IF([Sales] > [Avg] + 2 * [StDev], "Outlier") can drive conditional formatting.
items.zh: 像 IF([Sales] > [Avg] + 2 * [StDev], "Outlier") 这样的 DAX 标记可以驱动条件格式。

html.en: In the Power BI service, Metrics lets you build a scorecard: a list of metrics, each with a current value and a target, either typed in or connected to a value in a report. Each metric has an owner, a status (On track, At risk, Behind…), a due date, notes and check-ins. Status rules can change the status automatically. Share scorecards like other items, and add them to apps.
html.zh: 在 Power BI 服务中，指标功能可以建立记分卡：一份指标列表，每个指标都有当前值和目标值，可手动输入，也可连接到报表中的值。每个指标都有负责人、状态（正常、有风险、落后……）、到期日、备注和签到记录。状态规则可以自动改变状态。记分卡可以像其他项目一样分享，也可以加入应用。

q.en: Managers want to track ten quarterly targets, each connected to report data, with an owner and a status that updates automatically. What do you create?
q.zh: 经理们想跟踪十个季度目标，每个都连接报表数据，有负责人，状态还要自动更新。应该建立什么？

html.zh: 带 KPI 磁贴的仪表板

why.en: Tiles have no owners, statuses or check-ins.
why.zh: 磁贴没有负责人、状态或签到。

html.en: A scorecard with connected metrics and status rules
html.zh: 带连接指标和状态规则的记分卡

q.en: Which feature marks unexpected spikes and dips in a time series and suggests explanations?
q.zh: 哪个功能可以标出时间序列中意外的峰值和低谷，并提出解释？

html.en: Anomaly detection on a line chart
